game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater, a breakwater in a storm: the shipwright must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater: a breakwater in a storm
core_gameplay_loop: In Storm Breakwater, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round, a new pearls challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 70 points of pearls by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 70, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Storm Breakwater'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Storm Breakwater.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 70 within 42 seconds.
